scope.selection: Base DB map0 spawnlist_npc; inclusive village bounds plus the explicit Farlin crafting exception below. Keep zero-count rows and repeated template placements. Nonempty shop-product rows excluded; zero-shop L1Merchant services included and cross-referenced. Other outside-map0-village services/props stay adjacent and disabled by default.
scope.source_precedence: classic catalog fields and region first; L1J identity/behavior/placement only as attributed reference; no etc/name_id_test variant tables used

crafting_extension.note: Farlin crafting only; no global include_adjacent opt-in or village bounds change.

interpretation.confirmed_scope: confirmed_catalog_correspondence_only means a unique name-token/name/f2/SPR data correspondence, not confirmed classic placement, menu, NPC wire f39, spawned identity or live behavior. All placements remain L1J candidates.
interpretation.candidate_scope: Multiple token matches remain explicit and selected_classic_npc_id stays null; same numeric SPR alone is insufficient.
interpretation.menu_boundary: normal_action/caotic_action/teleport_url/teleport_urla are L1J SQL stems, not verified classic normalhtmlid/menu resources. Runtime 4E44 resource-stem handling and actual menu identity must be checked separately.
interpretation.sprite_type_boundary: declared_type is the SPR type command body in this catalog, not a verified packet-type assignment or Python behavior contract.
interpretation.execution_boundary: No game, server, port or L1J was run. This file adds no Python NPC behavior. Data-only checks do not establish service completion or full runtime equivalence.
interpretation.count_and_randomization: count0 is preserved as disabled L1J placement. randomx/randomy remain placement uncertainty; a center inside village is not a guarantee every random position is inside. Do not activate count0 or coalesce duplicate rows by inference.
interpretation.classification_boundary: Guide, craft and other exact service roles are not assigned from a generic L1Merchant class alone. Unresolved roles stay unresolved; town adviser/manager, inn menu, quests and crafting have distinct source-based labels.
